title: Quenched Sour Energizing Australian Milk Custard
description: A unique and refreshing Australian dessert featuring a sour and energizing twist on traditional milk custard, cooked in a clay pot.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, whisk together milk, lemons, maple syrup, coconut sugar, and salt.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture reaches 170°F (77°C).
In a small bowl, whisk together egg yolks and vanilla extract.
Gradually add the warm milk mixture to the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Return the mixture to the saucepan and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in activated charcoal powder until dissolved.
Pour the custard into a clay pot or small ceramic dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the center is slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, or until set.
Serve with fresh berries and a drizzle of coconut oil.
